name: unit-heights-reset-on
description: test.md 'Reset Fixed Object Heights: does it cover units?': no. Units with a height of their own in the file (footmen at 0 and 500 on a plateau of 256, one at 500 on flat ground, a gryphon at 0 on the plateau; fixtures/we-specs/make-unit-heights.mjs), the switch on as it starts: the editor saves each at the ground (256, 256, 0, 256); Studio's open and save does the same (savedUnitZ)

steps.eval: const s = await w3.services.get('w3.terrain'); for (let i = 0; i < 60 && !s.placedObjects()?.units?.length; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); window.__driveEd.pushEdit({ undo() {}, redo() {}, terrain: false, objects: false });

name: unit-heights-reset-off
description: the same with the Reset Fixed Object Heights switch off (the editor: Ctrl+Shift+H, seen in its Advanced menu in round 3; Studio: terrain.resetFixedHeights false): the units are saved at the ground either way
